rules.name: Schema and version integrity
rules.predicate: H02 batch and records use the frozen schema/version and object types.

rules.name: Immutable identity
rules.predicate: Record IDs and identity tuples are unique and cannot bind to conflicting content.

rules.name: Frozen scope
rules.predicate: Only CRYPTO / PERPETUAL / LINEAR instruments on BINANCE_USDM, BYBIT_LINEAR and OKX_SWAP are admitted.

rules.name: Canonical mapping
rules.predicate: Venue symbol to canonical instrument ID mapping is deterministic and unambiguous.

rules.name: Source receipt lineage
rules.predicate: Every admitted source object resolves to an immutable receipt and exact SHA-256 lineage.

rules.name: PIT timestamp ordering
rules.predicate: UTC timestamps satisfy event_time <= published_at <= available_at <= received_at after forward-only corrections.

rules.name: Lifecycle continuity
rules.predicate: Historical lifecycle transitions are contiguous, source-backed and non-conflicting.

rules.name: Source coverage
rules.predicate: Required source and normalized partition evidence exists for the frozen scope.

rules.name: Frozen research windows
rules.predicate: Coverage reconciles exactly to training 2023-01-01..2025-06-30, validation 2025-07-01..2026-03-31 and locked OOS 2026-04-01..2026-09-21.

rules.name: Known availability
rules.predicate: Evidence with unknown or non-provable availability time is blocked.

rules.name: A19 history
rules.predicate: Eligibility requires at least 90 days of PIT history and proven lifecycle state.

rules.name: A20 liquidity
rules.predicate: Liquidity eligibility uses the exact preceding 30-day PIT rolling median volume and frozen campaign threshold.

rules.name: Feature prerequisites
rules.predicate: All F3 feature inputs are present and available no later than each decision time.

rules.name: Cross-sectional breadth
rules.predicate: At least 8 instruments are simultaneously eligible at at least 80 percent of rebalance timestamps.

rules.name: Eligibility consistency
rules.predicate: Eligibility and exclusion records are deterministic, justified and mutually consistent.

rules.name: Record hash integrity
rules.predicate: All H02 record fingerprints recompute exactly.

rules.name: Manifest closure
rules.predicate: Every required H02 object and referenced artifact is closed by the batch manifest.

rules.name: Deterministic rebuild
rules.predicate: An independent rebuild produces identical dataset, universe, coverage, eligibility and replay fingerprints.

rules.name: Required series
rules.predicate: TRADES, ORDERBOOK, MARK_PRICE, INDEX_PRICE, FUNDING, OPEN_INTEREST, LIQUIDATIONS and INSTRUMENT_METADATA satisfy frozen coverage requirements.

rules.name: Coverage reconciliation
rules.predicate: Expected, observed, missing and partial interval counts reconcile for every coverage record.

rules.name: Gap accounting
rules.predicate: Every gap or partial interval is explicit, source-attributed and non-silent.

rules.name: Completion semantics
rules.predicate: COMPLETE is asserted only when no required interval is missing or partial.

rules.name: PIT membership
rules.predicate: Observations are usable only when their instrument definition was available and effective and lifecycle state was active at the PIT boundary.

rules.name: Decision-time boundary
rules.predicate: No observation, revision, feature source or lifecycle state crosses its decision-time visibility boundary.

rules.name: Liquidity policy binding
rules.predicate: Eligibility records bind to the frozen 30-day liquidity policy and campaign-specific threshold.

rules.name: Cross-artifact consistency
rules.predicate: Dataset, universe, lifecycle, coverage, eligibility, PIT and feature lineage agree on identity, scope, versions and hashes.

rules.name: Fail-closed evidence
rules.predicate: Missing, ambiguous or unprovable required evidence is BLOCKED and never silently inferred.

rules.name: Ruleset identity
rules.predicate: The executed ruleset identity, version and hash exactly match the frozen RR-001-030-v1 catalogue.

rules.name: Evidence conflict
rules.predicate: Overlapping accepted evidence cannot conflict; missing or ambiguous required evidence blocks.

rules.name: Authority boundary
rules.predicate: H02 is historical-data-only, do_not_promote remains true and it grants no OOS, PAPER, LIVE or broker-submission authority.
